subject: Staged redemption plan + onboarding steps for Snowbridge private offer
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@snowbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Staged redemption plan + onboarding steps for Snowbridge private offer

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, we sketched a staged redemption approach for the GCP private offer to make sure Snowbridge can ramp consumption without hitting invoice surprises. Attached is a lightweight projection (Snowbridge_MVP_usage_projection.xlsx) and a draft PO template so your procurement team can start the paperwork.

High-level proposal: 
- Phase 1 (month 0–3): Reserve 25% of committed SKU capacity for integration and pilot.
- Phase 2 (month 4–6): Gradual unlock to 60% as model workloads hit production.
- Phase 3 (month 7–12): Full burn to 100% with monthly reconciliation windows.

Operational asks from Snowbridge:
1) Confirm initial SKU mapping (we can provide model SKUs that match your token/embedding mix).
2) Signed PO (we can accept a simple PO referencing RBW-GCP-2027-SB-019).
3) SE contact for a 2-week integration window (we recommend a short co-sell/eng swap).

Next steps for our side: Marissa will own onboarding cadence and ops runbook; Ben will coordinate billing/PO intake. If that sounds good, can you share the procurement contact (or route the PO) and a preferred date for the pilot kickoff?

Best,
Karthik
Director, GCP Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Snowbridge_MVP_usage_projection.xlsx (xlsx), PO_template_Snowbridge.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@snowbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.t@snowbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged redemption plan + onboarding steps for Snowbridge private offer

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A few quick Qs before we loop procurement: 

- Can you confirm whether the reserved 25% in Phase 1 will be available across regions or is us-only? Our initial infra is cloud-native in us-central.
- What's the billing cadence — monthly invoice or upfront credit drawdown? Our finance team prefers monthly invoices where possible.
- For the SE contact, Michael (cc'd) will be the primary. He may need a separate calendar invite for the 2-week window.

I'll start an internal thread with procurement but wanted these clarified first.

Elena
VP Product & Partnerships
Snowbridge Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@snowbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged redemption plan + onboarding steps for Snowbridge private offer

Elena —

Answers inline: 
- Region: the Phase 1 reserve can be scoped to us-central only (we'll flag region routing in the PO). If you later want multi-region, we can add a small cross-region buffer in Phase 2.
- Billing cadence: for private offers we typically do monthly invoices tied to drawdown reconciliation. The PO can reference monthly billing with net-30. Ben, confirm if legal needs a different phrasing.
- SE kickoff: noted for Michael — I'll ask Marissa to send a 2-week integration calendar block.

Marissa: can you draft an ops runbook (onboarding-runbook-v1.md) that includes the SE calendar, model SKU mapping template, and a checklist for prefix/KV cache warmup?

Ben: please advise on the PO language and whether we should propose an escrow-style early draw for the first-month pilot.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@snowbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged redemption plan + onboarding steps for Snowbridge private offer

Karthik / team —

Couple operational notes from billing/legal: 
1) We should request a PO that references the private offer ID and includes a note: "Monthly invoiced drawdown against reserved commit; reconciliation monthly." That text avoids upfront escrow complexity and aligns with Snowbridge's ask.
2) If Snowbridge insists on reserved, we can set a 30% credit hold for the pilot and release credits as Phase 2 starts — legal prefers this as a short-term escrow term.
3) Need procurement contact for DocuSign routing. Elena, can your procurement team sign via DocuSign or do they require vendor-created PO?

I'll prepare the PO_template_Snowbridge.pdf with the suggested language and ping legal if they want a separate SOW clause for the SE involvement.

Ben
Sr. Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Marketplace handoff + DocuSign link (Snowbridge RBW-GCP-2027-SB-019)

Hi Elena / team —

Looping in marketplace ops for the private-offer finalize. A few concrete items before we can bind: 
- Please confirm the procurement contact and email to route DocuSign.
- I've generated the DocuSign envelope for PO RBW-GCP-2027-SB-019: https://docusign.redwood.com/envelopes/ABCD-7890 (internal link; placeholder until signature).
- We need to lock the SKU mapping sheet so it aligns with GCP billing SKUs; Marissa, please attach the SKU mapping to the DocuSign package.

If procurement prefers monthly invoicing with net-30 (per Ben) we can proceed without escrow. Otherwise we can set the 30% pilot credit hold.

I'll coordinate cutover with GCP co-sell once signature is complete — expected timeline: 1–2 business days to provision private-offer entitlements after signature.

Thanks,
Soojin
Marketplace Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-runbook-v1.md

From: Elena Park <elena.park@snowbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 12 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace handoff + DocuSign link (Snowbridge RBW-GCP-2027-SB-019)

Thanks everyone — procurement is ready to sign via DocuSign. Routing details: procurement@snowbridge.com. We'll go with monthly invoicing (net-30) and skip the pilot escrow. Michael will accept the SE calendar invite; propose kickoff 2027-05-17 for a two-week integration.

Elena
VP Product & Partnerships
Snowbridge Analytics
